# Ægis · Ægentisk

> AI-era development partner. Organisations that work with AI — and as AI.
> Based in Oslo, Norway. Founded by Thor Henning Hetland.

Ægis helps engineering teams adopt agentic development through talks, workshops,
advisory engagements, hands-on builds, and tooling. Human-led, production-grade.
Memory as infrastructure. Years of production use, not hype.

## Offerings

- Talks: keynotes at developer conferences and company events across the Nordics
- Workshops: hands-on team training on AI-era development, on your own codebase (open enrolment: 9,000 NOK/seat; next cohort: 21 May)
- Advisory: ægentisk maturity review — tech stacks, codebase readiness, blast radius, security, roadmap
- Hands-on: agentic development builds alongside your team (single feature → full ægentisk transformation)
- Tooling: Synthesis · ExoCortex · KCP · Skills Library — implementation and licensing

## Tooling

- Synthesis: Lucene-based knowledge index across entire codebase. Sub-second retrieval. 21 security signal types including AI-specific threats. Auto-generates skills from recurring session patterns. Reduces tool calls 40%.
- ExoCortex: human-led agentic workflow (declare → execute → verify). Human in the loop at decisions that matter, out of it everywhere else.
- KCP (Knowledge Context Protocol): federated org manifest via knowledge.yaml. Agents understand org structure without prompt-stuffing. Saves ~33% context. Open standard: github.com/Cantara/kcp
- Skills Library: 529 skills across Java, Spring, Kotlin, TypeScript, Python, React. Architecture, security, testing, performance, DX patterns. Auto-curated from real production sessions. Personal license included with every workshop seat.

## Methodology

SDD — Skill-Driven Development. Six-pillar method for AI-era engineering teams.
Iterative loop: build → test → change → learn → improve → repeat.

## People

Thor Henning Hetland (Totto) — founder. Four decades shipping production code across
Java, Kotlin, TypeScript, Python. Ægentisk practitioner, speaker at javaBin and Agentbrew Oslo.
